content.cast.the-reckoning.tobin.1.bark.0: 结束了吗？听上去她已经开始了。
content.cast.the-reckoning.tobin.1.bark.1: 你还能拔掉销钉。不。你已经拿定主意了。行吧。
content.cast.the-summons.tobin.0.bark.0: 是看守吗？不。抱歉，我还以为你是她。
content.cast.the-summons.tobin.0.bark.1: 这条锁链不用钥匙。是一根销钉。我就是够不到。
content.class.witness.blurb: 你在清算屋尚未清算时走遍其中，你在其中所做的一切就是看守者清算的依据。无战斗。
content.class.witness.kit.0.name: 伊索尔德·马罗的召唤
content.class.witness.kit.1.name: 见证者提灯
content.class.witness.name: 见证者
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.0.label: 拔掉销钉
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.0.tooltip: 你放了托宾。他走出这栋房子，回家去了。
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.1.label: 留他锁着
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.1.tooltip: 你把托宾留在牢房里等待清算。
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.text: 我不知道，这才叫我害怕。在这里待过的人，清算之后没有谁再提起过。把销钉从环里拔出来，锁链就开了。我在这儿够不到。
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-plea.opt.0.label: 你会怎么样？
content.dlg.tobin.tobin-plea.text: 你不是看守。好。我叫托宾·里夫。我家欠这栋房子三年粮食，它就要我们中的一个人锁在这里，一直到清算。今年是我。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ask.opt.0.label: 我们走一趟
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ask.opt.0.tooltip: 你去走遍这栋房子。伊索尔德会根据你的所作所为来清算。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ask.text: 在我清算之前，先走一走这栋房子。唤铃挂在门廊里：摇响它，谷里的人就会下到泥滩上来听我说话。门廊边的牢房里锁着一个人，抵他家的债。账簿就在这边的架子上，旁边的火盆是冷的。把账簿放进去，它就会烧起来。对每一样，按你觉得对的做法做。之后我会问你。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-bell.opt.0.label: 账簿呢？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-bell.opt.1.label: 我们走一趟
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-bell.text: 它挂在门廊的横梁上。摇响它，谷里的人听见了，就会下来。不摇它，清算就只是我一个人的事。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ledger.opt.0.label: 那铃呢？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ledger.opt.1.label: 我们走一趟
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ledger.text: 这山谷里的每一笔债都记在它上面，先是我母亲的手笔，然后是我的。它要是烧了，就没人欠这栋房子任何东西了。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-no.opt.0.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-no.opt.1.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-no.text: 没人敲响召集钟。山谷里的人都待在家里，没到泥滩来。明天我会亲口把这件事告诉他们。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-yes.opt.0.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-yes.opt.1.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-yes.text: 你敲响了召集钟。山谷里的人都下到泥滩上来听我说话，人数比我这些年见过的都多。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-no.opt.0.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-no.opt.1.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-no.text: 托宾·里夫还锁在牢房里。你听他说完，把他留在了那里。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-yes.opt.0.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-yes.opt.1.label: 继续
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-yes.text: 你放走了托宾·里夫。他现在已经走到半路了，他家的债也跟着他一起出了门。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-ledger-no.text: 账本还立在架子上。山谷的每一笔债都还写在里面。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-ledger-yes.text: 账本已经烧成火盆里的灰。这山谷的每一笔债都写在那上面，现在一笔也没了。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-verdict.opt.0.label: 就这样吧
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-verdict.opt.0.toolti: 伊索德给出对这屋的裁断，并照此行事。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-verdict.text: 那么，这屋已经清算了，我会告诉你它会怎样。站好别动。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.0.label: 清算吧
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.0.toolti: 伊索尔德现在根据你对铃、牢房和账簿的所作所为来清算这栋房子。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.1.label: 结算吧
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.1.toolti: 伊索尔德现在按你处理召集钟、牢房和账本的方式给房子结算。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.2.label: 还没有
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.text: 你在这栋房子里要做的事做完了吗？我一清算，就成定局了。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-summons.opt.0.label: 为什么叫我们来？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-summons.opt.1.label: 你需要什么？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-summons.text: 你们来了。我是伊索尔德·马罗，守着这栋房子。这里是清算屋：山谷里欠的债都记在这里，每年一次，在湖水被放干的时候，我清算它。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.opt.0.label: 那铃呢？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.opt.1.label: 账簿呢？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.opt.2.label: 我们走一趟
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.text: 牢房里的那个人叫托宾·里夫。先去听他说说。铃和账簿随你们处置，什么时候都行。
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-why.opt.0.label: 你需要什么？
content.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-why.text: 三十年来，我一直按自己的方式清算这栋房子，如今我已不知道那样做是否还有什么好处。你们不欠它什么。我想看看，不欠它的人会拿它怎么办。
content.fx.the-cell.oc.speak-to-tobin.1.narrate: 销子从铁环里拔了出来。铁链还没停下晃动，托宾已经越过你，冲出了门廊。
content.fx.the-cell.oc.speak-to-tobin.3.narrate: 你让托宾留在原地。身后，他一言不发。
content.fx.the-ledger.done.4.narrate: 你把账本放进火盆。旧纸页立刻烧起来，烧得干干净净。
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.0.narrate: 伊索德：“这屋再没什么可守的了，我不会让它空着立在这里。出去，全都出去。”
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.1.narrate: 伊索德：“这屋今年做了些好事。还能再立一年。”
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.2.narrate: 伊索德：“一座既没叫来任何人、也没放走任何人的屋子，没人需要。我会打开闸门，门也不关。水泽要，就拿去。”
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.12.narrate: 召唤钟把谷里的人引到了泥地上。他们亲眼看到了这场清算。
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.13.narrate: 没有人听见钟声。谷里的人明天会从伊索德那里得知这场清算。
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.14.narrate: 托宾·里夫天黑前就到家了。你放走了他。
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.15.narrate: 托宾·里夫仍被锁在牢房里，等候明年的清算。
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.16.narrate: 伊索德路过牢房时亲手拔掉了托宾的锁销。已经了结的屋子不关任何人。
content.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.17.narrate: 伊索德在出去的路上亲手拔掉了托宾的锁销。她不愿让一个人跟她的屋子一起烧掉。
content.fx.trig.ring-the-callbell.0.narrate: 传唤钟的钟声传过干涸的水泊。山谷上游，家家户户打开门，开始朝泥滩走去。
content.npc.tobin.name: 托宾·里夫
content.npc.ysolde.name: 伊索尔德·马罗
content.obj.the-cell.speak-to-tobin.hint: 牢房在门廊左侧低矮的门后，钟的下方。
content.obj.the-cell.speak-to-tobin.title: 听牢房里的人说话
content.obj.the-ledger.burn-the-ledger.title: 烧掉账本
content.obj.the-reckoning.hear-the-reckoning.hin: 伊索尔德在后面房间的祭坛旁等着。你处理完房子的事就告诉她。
content.obj.the-summons.hear-the-keeper.hint: 从神龛门进去，穿过拱门，到后面的房间。
content.obj.the-summons.hear-the-keeper.title: 找到管事
content.quest.the-cell.goal: 去门廊旁的牢房，听锁在那儿的人说话，再决定放他走还是留他。
content.quest.the-ledger.goal: 如果你认为该烧，就把记录山谷债务的账本扔进架子旁的火盆烧掉。
content.quest.the-reckoning.goal: 回到圣所的管事那里，听她根据你对钟、牢房和账本所做的事来清算这座房子。
content.quest.the-summons.goal: 进入账屋，听它的管事说她请你们来这里做什么。
content.world.outro: 温德米尔在夜里再次涨满，就像每年那样，漫过清算留下的一切。
content.world.title: 清算

source.cast.the-reckoning.tobin.1.bark.0: Is it over? It sounds like she's started.
source.cast.the-reckoning.tobin.1.bark.1: You could still pull the pin. No. You've decided. Fine.
source.cast.the-summons.tobin.0.bark.0: Is that the keeper? No. Sorry. I thought you were her.
source.cast.the-summons.tobin.0.bark.1: There's no key to this chain. It's a pin. I just can't reach it.
source.class.witness.blurb: You walk the Tallyhouse before it is reckoned, and what you do there is what the keeper reckons. No fighting.
source.class.witness.kit.0.name: Ysolde's summons
source.class.witness.kit.1.name: Witness's lantern
source.class.witness.name: Witness
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.0.label: Pull the pin.
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.0.tooltip: You free Tobin. He walks out of the house and home.
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.1.label: Leave him chained.
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.opt.1.tooltip: You leave Tobin in the cell for the reckoning.
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-fear.text: I don't know, and that's what frightens me. Nobody who was in here talks about the reckoning after. The chain comes off if you pull the pin out of the ring. I can't reach it from here.
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-plea.opt.0.label: What happens to you?
source.dlg.tobin.tobin-plea.text: You're not the keeper. Good. I'm Tobin Reave. My family owes this house three years of grain, and it keeps one of us chained in here until the reckoning. This year it's me.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ask.opt.0.label: We'll walk it.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ask.opt.0.tooltip: You go to walk the house. Ysolde will reckon it by what you do.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ask.text: Walk the house before I reckon it. The callbell hangs in the porch: ring it, and the valley comes down onto the mud to hear me. A man is chained in the cell off the porch, against his family's debt. And the ledger is here on its stand. The brazier beside it is cold. Lay the ledger in it and it burns. Do with each what you think right. I will ask you after.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-bell.opt.0.label: The ledger?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-bell.opt.1.label: We'll go.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-bell.text: It hangs from the beam in the porch. Ring it and the valley hears it and comes down. Leave it, and the reckoning is mine alone.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ledger.opt.0.label: The bell?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ledger.opt.1.label: We'll go.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-ledger.text: Every debt in this valley is written in it, my mother's hand and then mine. If it burns, nobody owes this house anything.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-no.opt.0.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-no.opt.1.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-no.text: Nobody rang the callbell. The valley stayed at home, and it will hear about this from me tomorrow.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-yes.opt.0.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-yes.opt.1.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-bell-yes.text: You rang the callbell. The valley came down onto the mud to hear me, more of them than I have seen in years.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-no.opt.0.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-no.opt.1.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-no.text: Tobin Reave is still chained in his cell. You heard him out, and you left him there.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-yes.opt.0.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-yes.opt.1.label: Go on.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-cell-yes.text: You let Tobin Reave go. He is halfway home by now, and his family's debt went out of the door with him.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-ledger-no.text: The ledger is still on its stand. Every debt in the valley is still written in it.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-ledger-yes.text: And the ledger is ash in the brazier. Every debt in this valley was written in it, and now none of them is.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-verdict.opt.0.label: So be it.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-verdict.opt.0.toolti: Ysolde gives her verdict on the house, and does what it says.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-r-verdict.text: Then the house is reckoned, and I will tell you what becomes of it. Stand where you are.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.0.label: Reckon it.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.0.toolti: Ysolde reckons the house now, by what you did with the bell, the cell and the ledger.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.1.label: Reckon it.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.1.toolti: Ysolde reckons the house now, by what you did with the bell, the cell and the ledger.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.opt.2.label: Not yet.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-reckoning.text: Have you done with the house what you meant to? Once I reckon it, it is reckoned.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-summons.opt.0.label: Why send for us?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-summons.opt.1.label: What do you need?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-summons.text: You came. I am Ysolde Marrow, and I keep this house. It is the Tallyhouse: what the valley owes is written here, and once a year, while the mere is let out, I reckon it.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.opt.0.label: The bell?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.opt.1.label: The ledger?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.opt.2.label: We'll go.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-walking.text: The man in the cell is Tobin Reave. Go and hear him first. The bell and the ledger are yours to do or leave, whenever you like.
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-why.opt.0.label: What do you need?
source.dlg.ysolde.ysolde-why.text: I have reckoned this house my own way for thirty years, and I no longer know whether it does any good. You owe it nothing. I want to see what people who owe it nothing do with it.
source.fx.the-cell.oc.speak-to-tobin.1.narrate: The pin comes out of the ring. Tobin is past you and out through the porch before the chain stops swinging.
source.fx.the-cell.oc.speak-to-tobin.3.narrate: You leave Tobin where he is. Behind you he says nothing at all.
source.fx.the-ledger.done.4.narrate: You lay the ledger in the brazier. The old pages catch at once and burn down to nothing.
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.0.narrate: Ysolde: "There is nothing left for this house to keep, and I will not leave it standing empty. Out, all of you."
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.1.narrate: Ysolde: "This house did some good this year. It can stand another."
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.2.narrate: Ysolde: "A house that called nobody and let nobody go is a house nobody needs. I am opening the sluice and leaving the doors open. The mere can have it."
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.12.narrate: The callbell brought the valley down onto the mud. Its people saw the reckoning with their own eyes.
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.13.narrate: Nobody heard a bell. The valley will learn of the reckoning tomorrow, from Ysolde.
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.14.narrate: Tobin Reave is home before dark. You let him go.
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.15.narrate: Tobin Reave stays chained in the cell, held for next year's reckoning.
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.16.narrate: Ysolde pulled Tobin's pin herself on her way past the cell. A house that is finished holds nobody.
source.fx.the-reckoning.done.3.then.17.narrate: Ysolde pulled Tobin's pin herself on her way out. She would not burn a man with her house.
source.fx.trig.ring-the-callbell.0.narrate: The callbell's note goes out over the dry mere. Up the valley, doors open, and people start down towards the mud.
source.npc.tobin.name: Tobin Reave
source.npc.ysolde.name: Ysolde Marrow
source.obj.the-cell.speak-to-tobin.hint: The cell is through the low door on the left of the porch, under the bell.
source.obj.the-cell.speak-to-tobin.title: Hear the man in the cell
source.obj.the-ledger.burn-the-ledger.title: Burn the ledger
source.obj.the-reckoning.hear-the-reckoning.hin: Ysolde is waiting by the altar in the room at the back. Tell her when you are done with the house.
source.obj.the-summons.hear-the-keeper.hint: Go in at the shrine door and on through the arch to the room at the back.
source.obj.the-summons.hear-the-keeper.title: Find the keeper
source.quest.the-cell.goal: Go to the cell off the porch, hear the man chained there, and free him or leave him.
source.quest.the-ledger.goal: Burn the ledger of the valley's debts in the brazier beside its stand, if you think it should burn.
source.quest.the-reckoning.goal: Go back to the keeper in the sanctum and hear her reckon the house by what you did with the bell, the cell and the ledger.
source.quest.the-summons.goal: Come into the Tallyhouse and hear from its keeper what she has asked you here to do.
source.world.outro: Wend Mere fills again in the night, as it does every year, over whatever the reckoning left.
source.world.title: The Reckoning
